settings.title: Settings
settings.mediaTailHelp: When a question’s sound or video lasts longer than its timer, the question is stretched to the end of the media plus this pause: nothing is cut mid-play.
settings.loudnessHelp: The level every sound and video of the quiz is brought to at playback, so the volume stays the same from one question to the next. The files are not changed.
settings.audioTargetHelp: Which devices play the sounds and videos of the quiz. Participants in the room see the projection: their phones stay silent unless "Every device" is chosen, which echoes if they share a room. A question can choose otherwise, and the host can change it for a session.
settings.languageHelp: The language the quiz is written in. Players see it in the templates, and a store filters by it.
settings.licenseHelp: The terms others may reuse the quiz under. Required to share it as a template. You must hold the rights to its content and media.
settings.tagsHelp: Up to 5 keywords to find the quiz among templates. Press Enter to add one.
settings.sharedLabel: Share with the instance’s other hosts
settings.sharedHelp: They see it in their quizzes, read-only, and can create their own copy from it. Unchecked, it stays yours alone.

broadcast.fullCaptureHelp: Keeps each player's answer details (individual tracking). Enable before presenting.
broadcast.fullCaptureNext: Full answer capture the next time it is played

feedback.enableHelp: A rating panel is offered at the end of the quiz, every time it is played.
feedback.title: Player feedback

slideForm.displayHint: In manual mode the host always moves on by hand.
slideForm.invalidError: A slide needs a title, some content or a media.
slideForm.videoCover: Fills the slide behind its content (cropped to the screen).
slideForm.videoLoopHint: Runs as long as the slide shows. Off: plays once and stays on its last frame — the slide waits for its end in auto mode.
slideForm.videoSoundHint: Plays the video’s own sound. Off: muted, and the slide can have a sound of its own.
slideForm.audioExcludesVideoSound: The slide already has a sound: one sound at a time. Remove it to turn the video’s on.
slideForm.videoSoundExcludesAudio: The video plays its own sound: no extra sound. Mute the video to add one.
slideForm.variablesHint: Write one in a heading or a text: it is replaced wherever the slide shows. The quiz’s appear filled in the preview, the room’s once the quiz is played.

variables.title: The quiz’s title
variables.author: Its author
variables.question: The number of the question that follows the slide
variables.total: How many questions the quiz has
variables.remaining: How many questions are left, the next one included

moveToDraft.title: Save this empty slide?
moveToDraft.description: This quiz is published, so it can be presented at any time: a slide must show something. Move the quiz back to draft to save this one as it is, or keep editing.

emptyPane.emptyHint: Start with a question, or with an intro slide.
emptyPane.selectHint: Pick an item in the list to edit it.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete this quiz?
deleteConfirm.description: “{{title}}” and its questions will be permanently deleted. This action cannot be undone.

questionForm.answerExplanationLabel: Answer explanation (shown with the right answer)
questionForm.answerExplanationPlaceholder: Why this is the right answer… (optional)
questionForm.revealDelayHint: In auto mode: how long the right answer stays on screen before moving on. Empty = the instance’s setting.
questionForm.audioTargetHint: Which devices play this question's sound or video. "Every device" includes the phones in the room, which echo if they share it.
questionForm.audioTargetDefault: The quiz's setting in the room
questionForm.waveformSizeHint: How thick the sound's waveform is drawn on the projection and the phones.
questionForm.waveformHiddenNote: Hidden on the projection and the phones — the sound still plays, and your console still shows it.
questionForm.orderAriaLabel: Place of answer {{index}} in the right order

multiple_choice.standard: All or nothing: every right answer ticked, and no wrong one.
multiple_choice.partial: Partial credit: each right tick earns its share, each wrong tick cancels one.

ordering.standard: All or nothing: every item in its place.
ordering.partial: Partial credit: share of the elements at the right position.

text_input.standard: Exact match, once case and accents are set aside.
text_input.lenient: Tolerate typos: one edit up to 5 letters, two beyond (after case/accent normalisation).

numeric.standard: Within the tolerance counts as right; points scale with speed.
numeric.closest: Closest answer wins: scored at the reveal — exact (within tolerance) = full points, then 75 / 50 / 30 %, 10 % beyond; no speed bonus.

image_choice.standard: All or nothing: every right picture ticked, and no wrong one.
image_choice.partial: Partial credit (several right pictures): each right tick earns its share, each wrong tick cancels one.

removeOptionConfirm.title: Remove this choice?
removeOptionConfirm.description: “{{label}}” will be removed from the question.

questionForm.stretchedTime: The media lasts {{media}} s: the question will last {{total}} s (end of the media + the quiz’s {{tail}} s pause).
questionForm.listenFirstLabel: Start the timer when the media ends
questionForm.listenFirstHint: Listen first, then answer: nobody can answer while the sound or video plays, and everyone gets the full time to think afterwards.
questionForm.listenFirstTime: The media plays {{media}} s, then the {{time}} s of answering start.
questionForm.promptImageNotice: This image in the prompt would be better in the question’s media: framed on every screen, zoomable on phones, loaded ahead.
questionForm.multiSelectHint: Participants tick every right picture, then submit — scored like a multiple choice.
questionForm.imageCropNote: Each picture is cropped to fill its tile, as the projection shows it.
questionForm.imageRequired: Choose a picture for this answer.
questionForm.imageAltPlaceholder: What the picture shows, for whoever cannot see it
questionForm.imageAltRequired: Describe the picture: it is the answer for whoever cannot see it.

imageCountConfirm.title: Keep only 2 pictures?
imageCountConfirm.description: The last two answers and their pictures will be removed.

questionForm.clampedTime: Set to {{value}} s: a question lasts {{min}} to {{max}} s.
questionForm.clampedReveal: Set to {{value}} s: the pause lasts {{min}} to {{max}} s.

moveToDraft.title: Save this unfinished question?
moveToDraft.description: This quiz is published, so it can be presented at any time: it only takes complete questions. Move it back to draft to save this one as it is, or keep editing.

questionForm.ticksCleared: The type changed: the right answers were cleared. Tick them again under the new rules.
questionForm.mediaPositionHint: Where the picture sits against the text; the answers stay below.

preview.noQuestions: This quiz has no questions yet.
preview.title: Preview

media.demoDisabled: Media uploads are disabled on the demo instance.
media.altPlaceholder: e.g. Kylian Mbappé in a France shirt
media.altHelp: Read aloud by screen readers. Describe what the image shows when it carries part of the question; leave it empty when the image is decoration.
media.videoExcludesAudio: The video already has its own sound: no extra audio track. Remove the video to add a sound.
media.audioExcludesVideo: A video already has its own sound: remove the sound to choose a video.

notice.gifFirstFrame: Animated GIF: only its first frame is kept.

library.search: Search by name, alt text or credit
library.empty: Nothing here yet: the media you upload are kept here, to use again.
library.deleteDescription: It is used by no quiz. Its file is deleted for good.
library.deleteError: The media could not be deleted.
library.creditReminder: Under a CC-BY licence, write the author and the licence in the media's credit.
library.instanceEmpty: The administrators have not provided any global media of this kind yet.

media.creditPlaceholder: e.g. Photo: Lin Wei, CC BY 4.0, openverse.org
media.creditHelp: Author, licence and source. Shown in the preview and at the end of the quiz — a CC-BY licence asks for it.

status.draft: Draft — publish the quiz to present it.
status.archived: Archived — restore it to edit or present it.

questionTypeHelp.single_choice: One correct answer among 2 to 8 choices. Points scale with speed, plus a streak bonus.
questionTypeHelp.multiple_choice: Several correct answers; the participant ticks then submits. All or nothing: the ticked set must match exactly.
questionTypeHelp.true_false: Two fixed choices, one correct. The fastest to play.
questionTypeHelp.text_input: The participant types the answer. Matched against the accepted answers ignoring case, accents and extra spaces.
questionTypeHelp.numeric: The participant enters a number; correct when within ± tolerance of the target.
questionTypeHelp.ordering: The participant sorts the choices into the order set by the positions (#). All or nothing.
questionTypeHelp.poll: Opinion only: no correct answer, no points; the distribution is shown at the reveal.
questionTypeHelp.image_choice: The answers are pictures, 2 or 4, each with its colour and shape. One right picture, or several when set; scored like a single or multiple choice.

sessions.liveEditsHint: Layout and presentation edits (backgrounds, contrast, explanations, slides) reach the rooms playing it at their next step; questions and answers stay as launched.

publication.title: Export for publication
publication.description: Checks the quiz against what the community store accepts, then downloads the file to upload to your quizdock-quizzes repository.

fix.ready: Mark the quiz as ready (Publish) first.
fix.settings: Set it in the quiz settings, under Sharing.
fix.size: Lighten or remove the heaviest media:
fix.credit: You are responsible for the rights to every image, sound and video you publish. Credit them in your media library (author, licence, source).

publication.slugHelp: How the store knows this quiz in your repository. File: {{file}}
publication.slugChanged: Changing it from “{{previous}}” makes a new quiz for the store: delete the old file from your repository.

readOnly.notice: {{owner}}'s quiz: you can read it, not change it.

publishChecklist.description: A published quiz can be presented at any time, so every question must be complete. Drafts keep whatever you save.

importReport.media: Pictures and sounds are not brought over.
importReport.incomplete_one: 1 question to finish before publishing: it is flagged in the list.
importReport.incomplete_other: {{count}} questions to finish before publishing: they are flagged in the list.

reasons.invalid_content: a text too long for QuizDock
